name: io.github.psd401/prr-staff-api
title: PSD401 Public Records Request staff API
description: Read and draft/propose tools over the PSD401 Public Records Act staff API.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: An attributed personal staff token, as `Token prr_pat_...`. Create one at /agent-access. This is the pre-OAuth credential model issue #294 tracks replacing; see _meta.net.psd401.registry/catalog.standard.

net.psd401.registry/catalog.riskTierReason: The staff API can return student education records governed by FERPA, so this server is Tier 3 under psd-dev-standards standards/07-mcp.md regardless of its tool surface being reads plus four draft/proposal tools. Tier 3 obligations are gateway-only access, per-user auth, human confirmation on destructive tools, and a full audit log.
net.psd401.registry/catalog.whatItDoes: Exposes the Public Records Act staff REST API to agents: request queues and status timelines, the statutory overdue list, collection tasks, the record-system registry, the RCW 42.56/FERPA exemption taxonomy, the append-only audit log, and the GUI/agent parity contract. Four hosted tools produce an editable acknowledgment or clarification draft, or a reviewable proposal, and nothing else.
net.psd401.registry/catalog.whoCanUseIt: Hosted /mcp: named district staff holding an attributed personal access token, subject to the same Django role policy and Google-group revalidation as the staff UI. Shared stdio: one dedicated nonstaff service identity holding only records.read_staff_api, which the write-tool allowlist rejects.
dataTouched: Public records request metadata and staff-visible status timelines
Requester contact details (PRA requester identity; minimized per compliance rule 5)
Student education records reachable through record items (FERPA)
Collection tasks, custodians, and the record-system registry
humanOnly: Status transitions, estimate revisions, denials, and closures
Approving, queueing, or sending any requester correspondence
Attaching an exemption citation, redaction, or withholding
Excluding a camera from a footage preservation hold

met: 1 - stateless streamable HTTP, no HTTP+SSE, no Roots/Sampling/Logging
3 - 12 tools under the ~15 ceiling, namespaced psd_prr_*, paginated and truncated with response_format, and the one unbounded scan now bounded without capping the statutory count it reports
4 - readOnlyHint and destructiveHint on every tool
5 - no elicitation of credentials; tokens are set as a header out of band
6 - this server.json, a README tool inventory, an eval suite, and an mcp-scan CI lane
7 - no tool has an irreversible effect; every legal effect is a human handoff in the staff UI
notMet: 2 - OAuth 2.1 resource-server pattern. Hosted /mcp still accepts a static attributed staff token and forwards it to the staff REST API. Tracked by issue #294; it depends on the Cognito gateway spine in the standards Phase 5 plan, which is ON HOLD, so it is deliberately not in the hygiene change that added this file.

net.psd401.registry/catalog.publishToPublicRegistryReason: The repository is private and the server reads PRA requester identity and FERPA-governed student records. This file exists for the internal PSD MCP directory only.
